text.content:
Distance, Range, and Movement

Instead of precise distances like 10 feet (3.5 m) or 90 feet (27 m), Cypher uses simple range categories for most distances: immediate, short, long, and very long.

Immediate distance or immediate range is what’s in reach of your character or within a few steps. At most, immediate distance is 10 feet (3.5 m).

Short distance is anything greater than immediate distance extending up to 50 feet (16 m) or so.

Long distance is anything greater than short distance extending up to 100 feet (30 m) or so.

Very long distance is anything greater than long distance extending up to 500 feet (150 m) or so.

Beyond very long distance, ranges are always specified—1,000 feet (300 m), a mile (1.6 km), and so on.

When you take an action, you can also move an immediate distance.

As your entire action for a turn, you can move a short distance instead of an immediate distance.

You can take an action and also move a short distance instead of an immediate distance, but all your tasks are hindered until the end of your next turn.

As your entire action for your turn, you can run a long distance, but all your tasks are hindered by two steps until the end of your next turn.
